question.text: Eagles at Cowboys on Thanksgiving 2026: will Dallas win by 7+ points, win by 1-6 points, or fail to win?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves on the final score of the Philadelphia Eagles at Dallas Cowboys Week 12 game scheduled for Thursday, November 26, 2026, at AT&T Stadium, as reported on the official NFL Game Center page (https://www.nfl.com/games/eagles-at-cowboys-2026-reg-12), where the margin is the Cowboys' final score minus the Eagles' final score, including any overtime. If that margin is 7 or more, the question resolves to "Cowboys win by 7 or more points". If the margin is between 1 and 6 inclusive, it resolves to "Cowboys win by 1 to 6 points". If the margin is 0 or negative, it resolves to "Cowboys do not win (Eagles win or the game ends in a tie)".
question.fine_print: If the NFL Game Center page is unavailable or does not show a final score, resolution uses [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions). If the game is not completed by November 28, 2026 (for example because it is postponed or cancelled), the question is annulled.

(c) **Base rates:** Since about 2000, 1-2 point favorites have won roughly 52-55% of games. About half of those wins come by 7 or more points. That gives roughly 27%, 27% and 46% for the three options. Favorites of about 3.5 points win around 60-62%. Dallas's high-scoring offense against a poor Eagles offense also makes a margin of 7+ somewhat more likely than at a typical -3 line.

Alternatively, the Eagles' collapse deepens after a blowout loss in Pittsburgh, and Dallas wins by 20+.
